newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae rises 2.45 pct, outstrips bourse.
newsitem.headline: Sonae rises 2.45 pct, outstrips bourse.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos gained 2.45 percent to 5,350 escudos, with some traders seeing upside as far as 5,500 short term, as the whole bourse continued to bubble on Friday.
But Sonae was outperforming the PSI20 index, which was gaining some 1.45 percent, and some traders said this could reflect expectations of a higher 1996 dividend payout.

The company recently announced it had raised its forecast for 1996 profit to 19 billion escudos from the 13.9 billion previously expected. But last week's news had had no immediate impact on the stock.
"There are no particular explanations for Sonae. The (investment) funds are full of money and the banks are betting on those shares with the best liquidity," said one trader.
"The next target is 5,500 escudos", said another trader, and "it could be reached pretty soon."
